THE WAGES BOARDS ORDINANCE
Notification
WAGES BOARD FOR THE TANNING, FOOTWEAR AND LEATHER GOODS MANUFACTURING TRADE

IN accordance with the provisions of Section 28 of the Wages Boards Ordinance (Chapter 136), the Wages Board for theTaning, Footwear and Leather Goods Manufacturing Trade hereby notifies that the Board, by virtue of the powers vested init by Section 30 of the aforesaid ordinance, proposes to vary in the manner set out in the Schedule hereto, such decisions ofthe Board as are specified in that schedule.
Objections to the aforesaid proposal will be received by the Chairman of the Board until 12.00 noon on 09th April,2015.
Every such objection must be made in writing and must contain a statement of the grounds upon which suchobjection is taken.

Classes of Workers
The Tanning of Leather :
Grade I:Washing raw hides, boiling hides in line, debarring the skins, Fleshing the skins, Applying chemicals, Bleaching,Oiling Shaving, Staking, Socking, Applying salt, Removing excessive oil.
Grade II:Splitting, Spraying, filling of salt hides, Trimming, Selecting and grading of skins, Buffing, Operating MachineSlickering.
Grade III :Application of flour and drying, curing the hides, the work of cleaners and sweepers, any other Operation connectedwith or incidental to the work specified above.

The Manufacture and Repair of Footwear :Grade I :Compounding, upper making, fabric pasting (Mechanical Cutting soles) Cutting uppers, Edge trimming, mountingbottom Pressing, Heel building, Heel compressing, clicking of uppers Edge setting.
Grade II:Loading, Pressing shoes, Binding uppers, Slotting, boring, Attaching buckles, stitching soles, Scouring, Skiving,Solution making, vamp setting, Eyeleting.

Grade III :Mixing rubber cement, cutting straps, Reverting uppers, dipping in cement, Inserting uppers, Preparing uppers,cementing back seams, pasting soles, polishing, finishing, Issuing boxes, Labelling boxes, Stamping boxes the work ofcleaners and sweepers, any other Operation connected with or incidental, to the work specified above.

The Manufacturing of Leather Goods :Grade I :Machine and hand clicking, Perforating and slit-cutting, Riveting, Hand pressing, Making Foot balls, Volley-ballsand Net-balls, Making Travelling bags, document cases and purses (machine).
Grade II:Fixing studs, Buckles and buttons, Embossing, Fixing locks, Fittings and handles sewing, Making Travelling bagsdocument cases and purses (machine).
Grade III :Marking Applying cement and Paste Finishing, Inflating and stamping, any other Operation connected with orincidental to work specified above.
Learners or Apprentices
The period of apprenticeship in relation to any learner or apprentice referred to above shall be deemed to consist of156 working days.
